name: TrendFollowingStrategy (EMA20 cross + OBV direction)
author: freqtrade-strategies
entry_long: Long: close crosses above EMA20 (close>EMA & close[-1]<=EMA[-1]) AND OBV>OBV[-1]
entry_short: Short: mirror cross below AND OBV<OBV[-1]
exit: exit_long: close crosses below EMA AND OBV rising(!); exit_short mirror (source ordering)
implementation_notes: Exit uses OBV opposite to entry - check intent. Freqtrade note: minimal_roi/stoploss are part of the published strategy; ROI exits are time-since-entry based. Source file is the sole spec; no independent verification of results.
